select * from ( select reg.totle_trade_id as busiCode, reg.trade_date as tradeDate, '04' as busiType, fp.finprod_id as finprodId, fp.finprod_market_id as finprodMarketId, fp.finprod_abbr as finprodAbbr, reg.ps as ps, reg.sec_manage_acct_id as secManageAcctId, stlinfo.sec_acct_name as secManageAcctIdName, reg.settle_speed as settleSpeed, reg.unit_cprice as unitCprice, reg.yield as yield, reg.exer_yield as exerYield, nvl(reg.face_value,0)/10000 as printAmt, reg.unit_int as unitInt, reg.unit_fprice as unitFprice, reg.cprice_amt as cpriceAmt, reg.int_amt as intAmt, reg.fprice_amt as fpriceAmt, regfee.trdFeeAmt as trdFeeAmt, regfee.settleFeeAmt as settleFeeAmt, deal.portfolioId as portfolioIds, deal.portfolioName as portfolioNames, reg.clear_type as clearType, reg.delivery_type as deliveryType, reg.ccy as ccy, reg.counter_id as counterId, mccic.PARTY_ABBR as counterIdName, reg.counter_trader as counterTrader, reg.remark as remark, reg.settle_date as settleDate from reg_fin_product_deal_total reg left join fin_product fp on reg.finprod_id=fp.finprod_id left join ( select fee.trade_id,sum(decode(fee.fee_type,'B06',fee.fee_amt)) as trdFeeAmt, sum(decode(fee.fee_type,'B08',fee.fee_amt)) as settleFeeAmt from reg_trade_fee_total fee group by fee.trade_id ) regfee on reg.totle_trade_id=regfee.trade_id left join( select regdeal.totle_trade_id,wm_concat(regdeal.portfolio_id) as portfolioId,wm_concat(pp.portfolio_name) portfolioName from reg_fin_product_deal regdeal left join ptl_portfolio pp on regdeal.portfolio_id=pp.portfolio_id where regdeal.totle_trade_id=#{busiCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} group by regdeal.totle_trade_id)deal on reg.totle_trade_id=deal.totle_trade_id left join stl_sec_acct_info stlinfo on reg.sec_manage_acct_id=stlinfo.sec_acct_id LEFT JOIN MST_CFETS_CUSTOMER_INFO mccic ON reg.counter_id= mccic.party_id where reg.totle_trade_id=#{busiCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and reg.finprod_type2='F01'
union all
select ib.quote_id as busiCode, ib.quote_date as tradeDate, ib.quote_type as busiType, fp.finprod_id as finprodId, fp.finprod_market_id as finprodMarketId, fp.finprod_abbr as finprodAbbr, ib.ps as ps, ib.sec_manage_acct_id as secManageAcctId, stlinfo.sec_acct_name as secManageAcctIdName, ib.settle_speed as settleSpeed, ibd.unit_cprice as unitCprice, ibd.yield as yield, ibd.exer_yield as exerYield, nvl(ib.share_amt,0)/100 as printAmt, ibd.unit_int as unitInt, ibd.unit_fprice as unitFprice, ibd.cprice_amt as cpriceAmt, ibd.int_amt as intAmt, ibd.fprice_amt as fpriceAmt, null as trdFeeAmt, null as settleFeeAmt, deal.portfolioId as portfolioIds, deal.portfolioName as portfolioNames, ib.sett_type as clearType, ib.delivery_type as deliveryType, ib.sett_ccy as ccy, ibd.cp_party_id as counterId, mccic.PARTY_ABBR as counterIdName, ibd.cp_trader as counterTrader, ib.remark as remark, ib.settle_date as settleDate from ibu_quote_bond ib left join fin_product fp on ib.finprod_id=fp.finprod_id left join ( select ibd.* from ibu_quote_bond_det ibd where ibd.quote_id=#{busiCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and rownum=1 order by ibd.update_time desc )ibd on ib.quote_id=ibd.quote_id left join( select ir.quote_id,wm_concat(ir.portfolio_id) as portfolioId,wm_concat(pp.portfolio_name) portfolioName from ibu_quote_etr_re ir left join ptl_portfolio pp on ir.portfolio_id=pp.portfolio_id where ir.quote_id=#{busiCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} group by ir.quote_id)deal on ib.quote_id=deal.quote_id left join stl_sec_acct_info stlinfo on ib.sec_manage_acct_id=stlinfo.sec_acct_id LEFT JOIN MST_CFETS_CUSTOMER_INFO mccic ON ibd.cp_party_id= mccic.party_id
where ib.quote_id=#{busiCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
order by ${sort} ${direction}
